localChanges: With ?interface=new, Add to queue in the list of what to build lines an item up after what the city is building now, and the city screen lists the queue under the production card, where each item can be moved up or down or removed (#774).
When one item is finished the next starts, and Auto or keeping on with military units only applies once the queue is empty. An item the city can no longer build is dropped, and you're told.
If a city can no longer build its current item, it asks you what to build next and keeps its queue; a city on Auto goes straight on to its queue. A captured city loses its queue.

log: CityBuild keeps a queue (civ-clone/web-renderer#774): enqueue, dequeue, requeue and clearQueue edit it, and queue() gives the items priced for the city, sent with the build. When an item is complete, or can no longer be built, the first queued item the city can still build starts, before the BuildingComplete and BuildingCancelled rules run, so a ruleset's own choices (Auto, standing orders) apply once the queue is empty. What it drops is in queueDropped(). A city that changes hands loses its queue; a player stopping the build keeps it.

A loaded entity keeps the keys it was saved with, so a build saved before the queue existed never sent `queue` or `queueDropped` (civ-clone/web-renderer#774). onHydrated adds the keys a build is missing, from the same list the constructor uses.

When the current item can no longer be built (a rival finished the Wonder), the city no longer goes straight on to its next queued item: it's left for its player to choose and told why, as without a queue, and the queue goes on after (civ-clone/web-renderer#774). Going on silently hid the loss.

A city on Auto whose item can no longer be built isn't asked, so it goes on to its queue before Auto chooses (civ-clone/web-renderer#774). choose() is build() for a player's choice: choosing the item first in the queue starts that one, rather than leaving it queued to be built twice.
fix: a negative position removes or moves the first queued item, not the last
feat: a city can queue what it builds after its current item
